Subject: Launchpad: Dedicated GPU MAP — FintechCo throughput targets & 8-week close plan

Hi Tom / Jake —

Great to speak last week. As promised, I’m kicking off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on evaluation steps, throughput targets, and a target close window for the dedicated GPU pool we discussed. Goal is to give FintechCo a predictable runway to evaluate performance and lock a committed pool before Q4 traffic ramps.

High-level MAP objectives:
- Confirm stakeholders and roles (see proposed RACI below)
- Run a 2-week throughput evaluation with our benchmark harness (we’ll provide scripts and sample prompts)
- Verify performance SLOs in your environment (target p95/p99 latency & sustained throughput)
- Finalize procurement + SOW and sign within 8 weeks

Proposed initial throughput targets (baseline for the evaluation):
- Sustained: 60 requests/sec (avg request ~256 tokens) with p95 < 220ms for 512-token responses
- Burst: 200 requests/sec for up to 10 minutes (for traffic spikes)
- Concurrency target: support 50 parallel sessions with KV cache enabled

Proposed kickoff meeting: 30-minute MAP sync this Thursday at 11:00 PT to confirm timeline and owners. I’ve attached a MAP worksheet and a short evaluation plan you can review before the call.

Proposed RACI (brief):
- FintechCo: Tom Baxter (POC / decision), Jake Li (SRE / test owner), Elisa (security/compliance)
- Redwood: Aisha Rahman (AM / MAP owner), Marcus Lin (SRE / eval owner), Rishi Malhotra (Sales lead / procurement)

Please confirm attendees and that the targets above look reasonable. If the throughput numbers look low/high for your workload, flag and we’ll adjust before the kickoff.

Attachments: FintechCo_MAP_Worksheet.xlsx, throughput-eval-plan.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

—
Aisha Rahman

Tom / Jake —

Appreciate the quick reply. I’m attaching a short technical evaluation plan and a checklist so your SREs can run the harness with minimal setup. Key notes below:

Evaluation plan (attached: throughput-eval-plan.pdf)
- Week 0 (prep): share test data, enable network access to the test endpoint, and sync on tokenization settings
- Week 1 (baseline): 60 rps steady-state test, 512-token responses, observe p95/p99 latency and memory/KV behavior
- Week 2 (stress + edge): bursts to 200 rps, long-sequence tails, and cache-warm scenarios

Benchmarks & metrics we’ll report back:
- p50/p95/p99 latency for 64/256/512 token responses
- tokens/sec and requests/sec across windows
- GPU utilization and host-level memory pressure
- KV cache hit rates and effective latency savings

Notes on config: we’ll provide a prebuilt Docker harness and a Redwood profile for the dedicated pool (quantization, batch size, and kernel presets). If you want to evaluate a quantized variant versus FP16, we can run both in parallel during Week 2.

I’ll be on the kickoff and will bring a short demo of the harness.

Attachments: throughput-eval-plan.pdf
